entries.text: Christians to be in fellowship with one another.
We should have fellowship in the gospel.
We are not to consent with sinners and evildoers, or walk with them, or sit down with them.
Do not be unequally yoked together with unbelievers; for what fellowship has righteousness with unrighteousness? And what communion has light with darkness.
Where two or three are gathered in Christ's name, He is there in the midst of them.
We are not to have fellowship with unfruitful works of darkness.
Bad company corrupts good habits and morals.
Christians are to work together each using their specific talents, abilities and ministries as one body, working towards God's will and His kingdom - For we are God's fellow workers.
We are to be like-minded with one another according to Christ Jesus, that we may with one mind glorify God.
If any come to you who do not have the doctrine of Christ, do not receive him into your house nor greet him.
Blessed is the man who walks not in the counsel of the ungodly.
It is good and pleasant for brethren to dwell together in unity.
With unity and fellowship comes strength, advantages, and benefits.
Do not keep company with fornicators, extortioners, the covetous, idolaters, slanderers, revilers, drunkards or the wicked, or brethren who walk contrary to God.
If we walk in the light as Christ is in the light, we have fellowship with one another.
Do not associate with a man given to anger, or go with a hot-tempered man, lest you learn his ways.
Unity exhorted by being like-minded one toward another according to Jesus Christ.
